hooks.command: jq -r 'if .tool_input.skill == "issue" then "match" else empty end' | grep -q match && { ISSUES=$(bun run magi issue list 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.[] | "  - [\(.id)] \(.title)"'); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"以下が既存のissueです。重複がないか確認してください。詳細は `bun run magi issue show <id>` で確認できます。\n%s"}}' "$ISSUES"; } || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$' && { bunx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null; bunx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null; } || true; }
